cards.example_en: School reports go home in June before the holiday begins.
cards.example_zh: 成绩单在假期开始前的六月发回家。

cards.example_en: Street markets stay open late in July because of the heat.
cards.example_zh: 因为天热，街市在七月会开到很晚。

cards.example_en: We visit my grandparents every August in the countryside.
cards.example_zh: 我们每年八月都去乡下看望爷爷奶奶。

cards.example_en: Our new school year always begins in September.
cards.example_zh: 我们的新学年总是在九月开始。

cards.example_en: We pick apples in October and bake them on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我们十月摘苹果，星期天把它们烤着吃。

cards.example_en: Leaves cover the path in November after the first strong wind.
cards.example_zh: 十一月第一场大风过后，小路上铺满了落叶。

cards.example_en: In December our class sells cards to raise money for the shelter.
cards.example_zh: 十二月里，我们班卖贺卡，为收容所筹款。

cards.example_en: One of my friends lives in Shanghai.
cards.example_zh: 我的一个朋友住在上海。

cards.example_en: I packed two shirts for the weekend at Grandma's house.
cards.example_zh: 我装了两件衬衫，准备去奶奶家过周末。

cards.example_en: We shared three sandwiches under the tree at noon.
cards.example_zh: 中午我们在树下分着吃了三个三明治。

cards.example_en: We need four chairs for the guests at dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭的时候，我们需要四把椅子给客人坐。

cards.example_en: Dad bought five apples for our picnic on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸买了五个苹果，准备周六去野餐。

cards.example_en: The alarm rings at six on exam mornings.
cards.example_zh: 考试当天早上，闹钟六点就会响。

cards.example_en: My little sister is seven and starts school this autumn.
cards.example_zh: 我妹妹七岁，今年秋天就要开始上学了。

cards.example_en: I wake up at eight when I have morning class.
cards.example_zh: 有早课的时候，我八点起床。

cards.example_en: The shop closes at nine on school nights.
cards.example_zh: 在上学日的晚上，这家店九点关门。

cards.example_en: Count to ten before you answer your brother in anger.
cards.example_zh: 先数到十，再在气头上回答你弟弟。

cards.example_en: The train leaves at eleven from platform two.
cards.example_zh: 火车十一点从二号站台出发。

cards.example_en: Lunch begins at twelve in the school dining hall.
cards.example_zh: 午餐十二点在学校食堂开始。

cards.example_en: Thirteen players waited on the bench during the game.
cards.example_zh: 比赛期间，十三名球员在替补席上等着。

cards.example_en: The cake serves fourteen people at my sister's party.
cards.example_zh: 这块蛋糕够我姐姐聚会上的十四个人吃。

cards.example_en: The ticket costs fifteen yuan for students on weekends.
cards.example_zh: 这张票在周末对学生卖十五元。

cards.example_en: She has sixteen crayons in the art box.
cards.example_zh: 她的美术盒里有十六支蜡笔。

cards.example_en: The bus fare is seventeen yuan to the city center.
cards.example_zh: 到市中心的公交车费是十七元。

cards.example_en: My brother turned eighteen and got a bus pass.
cards.example_zh: 我哥哥满了十八岁，还办了一张公交卡。

cards.example_en: Nineteen students signed up for the weekend hike.
cards.example_zh: 十九名学生报名参加了周末徒步。

cards.example_en: The coach made us run twenty laps around the track.
cards.example_zh: 教练让我们绕着跑道跑了二十圈。

cards.example_en: The speech should last thirty minutes in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 这场演讲在大厅里应该持续三十分钟。

cards.example_en: The classroom has forty seats around the new desks.
cards.example_zh: 教室里那些新课桌旁一共有四十个座位。

cards.example_en: We collected fifty bottles for the recycling drive.
cards.example_zh: 我们为回收活动收集了五十个瓶子。

cards.example_en: A minute has sixty seconds on the classroom clock.
cards.example_zh: 教室的钟上，一分钟有六十秒。

cards.example_en: About seventy parents came to the open day.
cards.example_zh: 大约七十位家长来参加了开放日。

cards.example_en: Grandpa walks eighty steps after dinner every evening.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷每天晚饭后都要走八十步。

cards.example_en: The boiling soup was nearly ninety degrees in the pot.
cards.example_zh: 锅里沸腾的汤差不多有九十度。

cards.example_en: The charity run raised one hundred yuan from our class.
cards.example_zh: 这次慈善长跑从我们班筹到了一百元。

cards.example_en: The mountain is over one thousand meters above the town.
cards.example_zh: 这座山比下面的小镇高出一千多米。

cards.example_en: That singer has one million fans in our country.
cards.example_zh: 那位歌手在我们国家有一百万名粉丝。

cards.example_en: Amy was first to finish the math paper today.
cards.example_zh: 艾米是今天第一个做完数学试卷的。

cards.example_en: She took second place in the piano competition.
cards.example_zh: 她在钢琴比赛中获得了第二名。

cards.example_en: The soup tasted right on my third attempt at the recipe.
cards.example_zh: 我第三次试做这个食谱时，汤的味道终于对了。

cards.example_en: Our team finished fourth at the school sports meeting.
cards.example_zh: 我们队在校运动会上获得了第四名。

cards.example_en: Ben sits in the fifth row near the classroom window.
cards.example_zh: 本坐在靠近教室窗户的第五排。

cards.example_en: Turn left at the sixth street after the bridge.
cards.example_zh: 过了桥之后，在第六条街向左转。

cards.example_en: He scored in the seventh minute of the football match.
cards.example_zh: 他在足球比赛的第七分钟进了一个球。

cards.example_en: She finished eighth in the city swimming race.
cards.example_zh: 她在全市游泳比赛中获得了第八名。

cards.example_en: December is the ninth month on our classroom calendar.
cards.example_zh: 十二月是我们教室日历上的第九个月。

cards.example_en: Today is the tenth of March and spring feels near.
cards.example_zh: 今天是三月十日，春天感觉已经近了。

cards.example_en: She came eleventh in the cross-country race.
cards.example_zh: 她在越野赛中获得第十一名。

cards.example_en: December is the twelfth month.
cards.example_zh: 十二月是第十二个月。

cards.example_en: He lives on the thirteenth floor of that block.
cards.example_zh: 他住在那栋楼的十三层。

word.example_en: At first sight the map looks simple.
word.example_zh: 乍一看，这张地图很简单。
